source_quality_notes: GCN 46243 title names 01709322272, while its body explicitly names 01709322455, cites 46238 and identifies G 6-43.
GCN 46243 start 2026-11-12T13:32:57.630Z is 10.51 min after the 13:22:27Z trigger, inconsistent with its approximate 6.75-min statement; the uncertain optical timing is not adopted.
EP261111a WXT light curve interrupted after approximately 60 s; do not equate observed interval with intrinsic duration.
EP261105a chance-alignment estimate assumes a higher-redshift galaxy and a specified association radius; not a posterior source-identification probability.
GCN 46240 is a new report of a 10 November observation, not a new 12 November burst.
